segments.text: And as Chriſt for the keeping of this Church in holy and orderly Communion, placeth ſome ſpeciall men over the Church, who by their office are to governe, overſee, viſit, watch; ſo likewiſe for the better keeping thereof in all places, by the members, he hath given authoritie, and laid dutie upon all, to watch over one another.
